release_notes:
## Fixes
- The version number is now stored inside the app's own code instead of in a separate file it had to go looking for. That lookup was failing on at least one install, which is what produced "vunknown" — the version can no longer fail to load, whatever state the rest of the install is in
- About now reports whether the update manifest agrees with the running code. If it doesn't, it lists every path that was checked and what was wrong with each, plus where the app is running from. A disagreement is worth knowing about beyond the version number, because the same file writes also deliver the bug icon, thinking animation and AME presets
- The app saves a copy of its version to Application Support as soon as it can read one, rather than only during an update

## Earlier fixes, still included
- The "update available" bar no longer reappears after you have already updated
- Social Media exports find the Watermark track whatever the clip is named (1.0.8)
- Mute Master Clips no longer mutes more tracks than intended (1.0.8)
- Mute Master Clips failing to mute at all is still NOT fixed. The nest log reports every video track's real mute state at three points — after the un-mute/target step, after the mute step, and on the first nested episode. One nest run with the box checked, and those three lines, is what's needed to fix it
